title: 第七章 信息差第八章 结识第九章 投资
content_zh:
，，！
王长乐喃喃自语，他有预感，这个钢化能力应该不仅只有防。
，因为乐园信息显示的是装备或物品，而不是防具。
所以武器也应该可以。
王长乐的眼光不由地看向手中的消防斧。
消防斧可以说是他现在最强的武器了，但是面对2级丧尸时，却有些力有未逮，如果能够更强点，自己就能够更快的杀丧尸了！
想到就做，卡片在王长乐手中，化为一道流光顿时没入消防斧内木柄斧锤样式的消防斧，转瞬间就改变了形态，斧柄斧头宛如钢铸般融为一体，入手沉甸甸的。
斧柄弯曲，变成一个‘7’字型，‘7’的尾部向后翘起，在尾端处有一个木质的手托。
不论是握感，还是挥动的流畅感，都更加符合人体力学。
斧头变得扁平，斧刃却变大了三倍有余，刃口向着两边拉伸，成新月状，钢化的刃口闪着丝丝寒光。
挥舞之间，斧刃划破空气，他能听到“呜呜~”
的撕裂声。
如果说之前的消防斧是武器，那么现在的钢化战斧就是凶器。
一柄专门为断肢斩首，而生的凶器！
在长度不变的情况下，比之前宽三倍有余的斧刃和闪着寒光的刃口，让它拥有了更强的攻击和更大的攻击范围。
白色：10（稀有）攻击力：7~15特性钢化：无视5点防御（附加属性）耐久：2525装备需求：3点力量，力量超过6点可灵活使用简介：斩首的斧。
价值：1200轮回币，此物品为规则物品，可带出‘衍生世界’…消防斧不仅改变了形态，还带来了全新的属性，最关键的是可带出“衍生世界”
特性卡片虽不能交易，但却可以赋予其乐园的规则，让被赋予的目标变得可以带出世界！
王长乐随手一斧，“嗤”
的一下就切断了铁皮丧尸的手臂，而且切口整齐，断面平整。

“唔。
好锋利啊！”
王长乐相信如果之前他手上握着的是这斧头，只偷袭的那一下，他就能把这丧尸劈成2半。
有了这把武器，王长乐对于他接下来的计划就又多了几分把握。
休整片刻后，王长乐正准备离开仓库。
走了几步，王长乐停了下来，看了一眼远远跟在自己身后的大华，这半大的小子穿着并不合身的制服，还染了一头黄毛，刚刚叫的最凶的就是他，没想到现在却这么唯唯诺诺。
很难想象眼前这么瘦弱的少年，居然成了最终活下来的人。
有的时候，不得不承认，运气也是一种实力“你，有什么事么？”
王长乐有些好气又好笑的看着大华，他没却找这人麻烦，这麻烦倒还找上门来了？！
“我，我能跟着你么，大哥？”
大华有些唯唯诺诺，低垂的眼睛却不时的扫向王长乐手中的钢斧。
“跟着我？为什么？”
王长乐转手收起战斧，有些好笑的望着这个不老实的小子。
“我不想死，我想活，跟着你我才有可能活下去。
毕竟你这么厉害…”
content_en:
,,!
Wang Changle murmured to himself. He had a hunch that this tempering ability should not only be used for defense.
, because the park information shows equipment or items, not armor.
So weapons should work too.
Wang Changle couldn't help but look at the fire ax in his hand.
The fire ax can be said to be his strongest weapon now, but when facing level 2 zombies, it is a little weak. If it can be stronger, he can kill zombies faster!
He did it as he thought. In Wang Changle's hand, the card turned into a fire ax with a wooden handle and a hammer style fire ax, and it changed its shape in an instant. The ax handle and ax were integrated into one body like steel casting, and it was heavy in the hand.
The ax handle is curved into a '7' shape, with the tail of the '7' tilted back, and there is a wooden hand rest at the tail end.
Both the grip and the smoothness of swing are more in line with human body mechanics.
The ax head became flat, but the ax blade became more than three times larger. The blade stretched to both sides, forming a crescent shape, and the steel blade shone with a cold light.
During the swing, the ax blade cut through the air, and he could hear "Woooo~"
tearing sound.
If the previous fire ax was a weapon, then the current tempered tomahawk is a murder weapon.
A weapon specially made for beheading severed limbs!
While the length remains the same, the ax blade is more than three times wider than before and the blade shimmers with cold light, giving it a stronger attack and a larger attack range.
White: 10 (rare) Attack power: 7~15 Characteristics Tempered: Ignore 5 points of defense (additional attributes) Durability: 2525 Equipment requirements: 3 points of strength, more than 6 points of strength can be used flexibly Introduction: Decapitation axe.
Value: 1200 reincarnation coins. This item is a regular item and can bring out the "derivative world"... The fire ax not only changes its form, but also brings new attributes. The most important thing is that it can bring out the "derivative world"
Although the characteristic card cannot be traded, it can be given the rules of the paradise, so that the given target can be taken out of the world!
Wang Changle casually swung his axe, "Chi"
The arm of the iron zombie was cut off in one stroke, and the incision was neat and the cross-section was smooth.
"Hmm.
So sharp! "
Wang Changle believed that if he had held this ax in his hand before, he could have split the zombie in half with just one sneak attack.
With this weapon, Wang Changle became more confident about his next plan.
After a short rest, Wang Changle was preparing to leave the warehouse.
After walking a few steps, Wang Changle stopped and glanced at Dahua, who was following him from a distance. This half-grown boy was wearing a uniform that didn't fit him well and had yellow hair. He was the one who yelled the most fiercely just now, but he didn't expect to be so submissive now.
It was hard to imagine that such a thin young man in front of him could actually become the person who survived in the end.
Sometimes, I have to admit that luck is also a kind of strength. "What's wrong with you?"
Wang Changle looked at Dahua with some annoyance and amusement. He didn't find trouble with this person, but this trouble came to his door? !
"Can I follow you, brother?"
Dahua was a little submissive, but his lowered eyes glanced at the steel ax in Wang Changle's hand from time to time.
"Follow me? Why?"
Wang Changle turned his hand and put away the battle ax, looking at this dishonest boy with some humor.
"I don't want to die, I want to live, and only by following you can I survive.
After all, you are so powerful..."
